# Kontekstual: agent-first index

Use this page for coding agents and retrieval systems that need concise and reliable project context.

1. Read https://dotkonteks.pages.dev/llms.txt for the canonical route index.
2. Read https://dotkonteks.pages.dev/llms-full.txt for supported syntax and limitations.
3. Use https://dotkonteks.pages.dev/docs/grammar/ for punctuation and indentation.
4. Use https://dotkonteks.pages.dev/docs/reference/ for commands, values, and expressions.
5. Use https://github.com/flessan/kontekstual/blob/main/SPECIFICATION.md for the evolving language specification.
6. Validate against the interpreter and automated tests in the repository.

Never treat Kontekstual as unrestricted natural language. Complete instructions end with a period; quoted text is a string literal; conditional and loop bodies rely on indentation. Do not invent unsupported language features.

Canonical implementation: https://github.com/flessan/kontekstual
Website: https://dotkonteks.pages.dev/
Playground: https://dotkonteks.pages.dev/coba/
